title: Spectral coherence of the Q90 zero-row-sum pair-interaction residual

target_design.split_rule: q90.split_labels(total), using the registered 60/20/20 chronological partition
target_design.cutoff_rule: For target i, compute field state, edge change, decomposition and all rankings using draws[:i] only; freeze rankings before reading draw i.

hypothesis: The large Q90 pair-interaction residual may contain predictive structure concentrated in a small number of coherent spectral modes; fixed low-rank spectral operators may produce a more useful node-to-field transfer signal than the full residual projection.

spectral_definition.residual: E_pair from q90.decompose_edge_change(E_t-E_(t-1)); symmetric, zero diagonal and zero row sums.
spectral_definition.decomposition: eigh(E_pair); sort nonzero eigenmodes by descending absolute eigenvalue; include the full tie group at the k-th absolute-eigenvalue boundary; S_k=V_k diag(lambda_k) V_k.T.
spectral_definition.signal: For each node i, signed cosine(node_delta_i, (S_k @ prior_features)_i); smooth with EWMA window 20, decay 0.80.
spectral_definition.mode_tie_rule: Include all modes tied at the absolute-eigenvalue cutoff within 1e-10*max(1,cutoff); report effective mode count. This avoids arbitrary truncation inside a degenerate eigenspace.

spectral_null.construction: For each fixed permutation P, S_perm=P S_2 P.T. This preserves eigenvalues, symmetry and the all-ones null direction; it also preserves the diagonal pattern of S_2. It randomizes the alignment of spectral modes with the original node labels. It is a constrained node-label null, not a Haar-random eigenvector rotation.
spectral_null.tests: For each chronological split and Top5/Top10/Top20, compare the observed k=2 mean hits with the 99 permuted spectral operators; use plus-one randomization p-values and one global Holm family of 9 tests.

statistics.exact_null: 72 tests: 8 named models x 3 chronological splits x Top5/Top10/Top20; exact Hypergeometric(40,k,5) upper-tail null and one global Holm family.
statistics.paired: 48 tests: Validation and historical Blind OOS x 6 comparators (full edge, degree/main, pair residual, node-only, Equal42, mean of 99 node-label permutations) x Top5/Top10/Top20/mean actual rank; circular moving-block bootstrap length 20, 2,000 replicates, one global Holm family.
statistics.randomization: 9 tests: 3 splits x Top5/Top10/Top20 for the focal k=2 model versus 99 fixed node-label spectral permutations; plus-one randomization p-values and one global Holm family.
statistics.primary_gate: On historical Blind OOS, fixed Q93::SPECTRAL_K2 must exceed Q90::PAIR_INTERACTION_TRANSFER, BASE::EQUAL42 and the mean of 99 spectral node-label permutations by at least 0.10 Top20 hits/target; each paired block-bootstrap 95% CI lower bound must be >0 and Holm p<0.05; focal exact-null Holm p<0.05; focal k=2 vs permutation randomization Holm p<0.05. This historical slice is exploratory and cannot establish prospective confirmation.

safeguards: Archive byte identity is pinned; no archive rewrite after registration.
Every target uses draws[:i]; no current or future outcome enters features, eigendecomposition, smoothing or ranking.
The spectral mode count k and all transfer parameters are fixed before evaluation; no Validation or Blind OOS tuning.
Degenerate eigenvalue ties are included as complete eigenspaces and effective mode counts are recorded.
The spectral null uses 99 fixed node-label permutation conjugations, preserving eigenvalues, symmetry and the all-ones null direction; it does not claim arbitrary Haar orientation.
All rankings are frozen before reading the target quintet.
One global Holm family for exact-null tests, one for paired bootstrap tests and one for spectral randomization tests.
Moving-block bootstrap is reported separately because exact hypergeometric tests assume independent target draws.
Historical Blind OOS has been exposed in prior SONAR experiments; it is exploratory, not virgin holdout.
The pair graph is a statistical co-occurrence descriptor, not physical coupling or proof of causality.
No immutable freeze modification, no prospective shadow insertion, no model promotion and no automatic merge.
